snippet.title: Cronos: The New Dawn | Deep Dive into The Combat
snippet.description:
⚔️ The new dev diary is live — and it dives deep into a combat system where Orphans merge with corpses to evolve mid-battle. Every encounter shifts. New abilities. Different behavior. A new survival strategy.
 
📽️ Watch the full dev diary with: Game Director Jacek Zięba and Lead Combat Designer Shamil Yanbukhtin.

Cronos: The New Dawn is coming to PC, PlayStation5 and Xbox Series X/S this fall!
